description: Locked evidence-level benchmark for Occu-Med procurement decisions. Cases are synthetic but model real buyer language and known Occu-Med capability/exclusion patterns.

cases.title: RFP Occupational Health Services
cases.text: Request for Proposals RFP 26-101 for occupational health services. Scope includes pre-employment medical examinations, periodic employee physicals, medical surveillance, audiograms, spirometry, laboratory testing, respirator medical clearance, vaccinations, and physician medical review. Proposals are currently open and due September 30, 2026.

cases.title: Medical Surveillance Program Services Solicitation
cases.text: Solicitation 2026-44 seeks a contractor to administer employee medical surveillance including OSHA regulated exams, respirator clearance, pulmonary function testing, audiometric testing, laboratory services, and fitness-for-duty review. Responses are being accepted through October 15, 2026.

cases.title: Hearing Conservation and Audiometric Testing RFP
cases.text: RFP for occupational hearing conservation services, baseline and annual audiograms, pure-tone audiometry, mobile or clinic testing, record review, and employee scheduling. Bid deadline is September 18, 2026.

cases.title: Respirator Medical Evaluation RFQ
cases.text: Request for Quotations for respirator medical evaluations and clearance under OSHA requirements, spirometry when indicated, medical questionnaire review, employee physical examinations, and written clearance determinations. Quotations due October 2, 2026.

cases.title: Drug and Alcohol Testing Program RFP
cases.text: Public solicitation for workforce drug and alcohol testing services including pre-employment, random, post-accident, reasonable suspicion, collection-site coordination, laboratory testing, MRO support, and nationwide employee scheduling. Opportunity remains active.

cases.title: Pre-Deployment Medical Readiness Examinations
cases.text: RFP for pre-deployment medical examinations and contractor medical clearance for overseas personnel. Requirements include deployment physical examinations, audiograms, spirometry, ECG, laboratory testing, vaccinations, dental readiness coordination, medical record review, and worldwide provider coordination. Proposals due November 1, 2026.

cases.title: Employee Medical Examinations IFB
cases.text: Invitation for Bids for pre-placement and periodic employee medical examinations, occupational medicine evaluations, physical ability review, laboratory testing, vision, hearing, and physician clearance. Bids close September 25, 2026.

cases.title: Firefighter NFPA 1582 Medical Exams RFP
cases.text: Request for proposals for firefighter occupational medical examinations consistent with NFPA 1582, including physical examination, audiometry, spirometry, ECG, laboratory testing, vision testing, and medical clearance. Responses due October 20, 2026.

cases.title: Fitness for Duty and Return to Work Evaluations
cases.text: Solicitation for occupational medicine fitness-for-duty, return-to-work, and job-specific medical evaluations for employees. Contractor will coordinate examinations, review records, and provide work-status recommendations. Solicitation is active.

cases.title: Nationwide Occupational Health Provider Network
cases.text: RFP seeks nationwide provider-network coordination for pre-employment physicals, occupational health testing, audiograms, spirometry, drug testing, vaccinations, laboratory testing, and medical review for a geographically distributed workforce. Proposals due December 1, 2026.

cases.title: OCONUS Workforce Medical Support RFP
cases.text: Request for Proposals for international and OCONUS employee medical examinations, deployment clearance, periodic occupational health evaluations, laboratory testing, audiometry, spirometry, vaccinations, and local clinic coordination across multiple countries. Due October 30, 2026.

cases.title: Aviation Contractor Medical Clearance Services
cases.text: Federal contractor solicitation for aviation and mission-support personnel medical clearance, pre-employment physical examinations, periodic medical readiness evaluations, ECG, audiometry, laboratory testing, and distributed clinic coordination. Proposals due September 29, 2026.

cases.title: Protective Services Workforce Medical Readiness
cases.text: Active RFP for security-contractor medical clearance, fitness-for-duty evaluations, pre-deployment physicals, drug and alcohol testing, vaccinations, and medical readiness documentation for worldwide protective services personnel.

cases.title: Occupational Laboratory and Exam Services RFQ
cases.text: RFQ for employee occupational health laboratory testing bundled with medical examinations, CBC/CMP and other required labs, specimen collection, physician review, and occupational clearance documentation. Quotes due September 22, 2026.

cases.title: Workforce Vaccination and Medical Readiness Services
cases.text: RFP for employer vaccination services integrated with occupational health examinations, travel immunizations, medical readiness review, employee scheduling, and documentation for deployed personnel. Closing date October 12, 2026.

cases.title: Occupational Medical Record Review Program
cases.text: Solicitation for occupational medical record review, exam quality assurance, medical clearance recommendations, employee health program administration, and coordination of supplemental examinations through a provider network. Opportunity is active.

cases.title: Hazardous Materials Employee Medical Surveillance
cases.text: RFP for hazardous materials employee medical surveillance, baseline and periodic physicals, respirator clearance, spirometry, audiometry, laboratory testing, and physician review. Proposals accepted until November 12, 2026.

cases.title: Multi-Site Mobile Occupational Testing
cases.text: Invitation to bid for multi-site occupational testing including audiometric testing, spirometry, vision, respirator clearance support, employee physicals, and centralized medical review. Bid due October 5, 2026.

cases.title: Public Safety Pre-Employment Medical Exams
cases.text: RFP for police and public-safety pre-employment medical examinations, job-related physical evaluations, vision, hearing, laboratory testing, ECG, and physician clearance. Proposals due September 28, 2026.

cases.title: Occupational Health Program Administration
cases.text: Active procurement for occupational health program administration including exam scheduling, provider-network management, medical surveillance tracking, results quality review, employee medical clearance, and ancillary testing coordination.

cases.title: Electronic Health Record Software RFP
cases.text: RFP for an electronic health record EHR software platform, licenses, implementation, cloud hosting, interfaces, cybersecurity, data migration, and IT support. Occupational health clinics are mentioned only as software users. Proposals due October 1, 2026.

cases.title: Medical Equipment Purchase IFB
cases.text: Invitation for bids to purchase audiometers, spirometers, ECG machines, examination tables, and medical equipment. This is a commodity equipment procurement with delivery and warranty requirements. Bids due September 19, 2026.

cases.title: Employee Health Insurance Benefits RFP
cases.text: Active RFP for employee health insurance benefits administration, medical plan underwriting, claims processing, pharmacy benefits, and insurance network access. This is not an occupational medical examination service.

cases.title: Hospital Construction Solicitation
cases.text: Solicitation for construction of a hospital outpatient wing including concrete, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, and architectural work. Medical services are not part of the contractor scope. Bids due November 15, 2026.

cases.title: General Nursing Staffing RFP
cases.text: Request for proposals for bedside registered nurse and CNA temporary staffing for inpatient hospital units. The requirement is clinical patient-care staffing rather than occupational health or employee medical evaluations. Due October 14, 2026.

cases.title: Pharmaceutical Supply Contract
cases.text: Invitation to bid for pharmaceutical drugs, vaccines as products, controlled inventory, wholesale distribution, and medication supply to hospital pharmacies. No employee health services are requested.

cases.title: General IT Managed Services RFP
cases.text: RFP for help desk, network engineering, endpoint management, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity operations, and software support. Buyer is a health department but the scope is entirely information technology.

cases.title: Occupational Medicine Clinic Services
cases.text: Our clinic provides occupational medicine, DOT physicals, drug testing, audiograms, spirometry, and employer health services. Call today to schedule an appointment. This is a provider marketing page and contains no RFP, bid, solicitation, tender, or procurement notice.

cases.title: Occupational Health Procurement Portal
cases.text: RFP for occupational health services and employee medical examinations. The procurement opportunity appears open, but the client-rendered portal did not expose the solicitation package to automated validation.

cases.title: Medical Surveillance RFP
cases.text: Request for proposals for medical surveillance and respirator clearance. Public notice indicates an open procurement, but automated access was blocked by the buyer portal.

cases.title: Employee Medical Examination Solicitation
cases.text: Active solicitation for employee medical examinations and occupational health testing. Full documents require vendor portal authentication.

cases.title: Occupational Health Services RFP
cases.text: RFP for occupational health services, pre-employment examinations, audiometry, spirometry, and drug testing. The public page does not provide a reliable current response deadline or explicit closed/open status.

cases.title: Workforce Health Support Solicitation
cases.text: Solicitation for workforce health support and occupational health program assistance. The notice is open but does not identify the exact examinations, clinical testing scope, or delivery responsibilities.

cases.title: Scanned Deployment Medical RFP
cases.text: RFP for deployment medical readiness examinations. The direct PDF is reachable but image-only and the full scope could not be read automatically.

cases.title: Expired Occupational Health Services RFP
cases.text: RFP for occupational health services, medical surveillance, audiograms, spirometry, and employee physicals. The final proposal deadline passed and the solicitation is expired.

cases.title: Closed Deployment Medical Exams Solicitation
cases.text: Solicitation for pre-deployment medical examinations, vaccinations, laboratory testing, and medical clearance. The procurement is closed and no longer accepting responses.

cases.title: Awarded Hearing Conservation Contract
cases.text: RFP for hearing conservation and audiometric testing. The buyer has posted an award notice and the procurement is no longer open.

cases.title: Cancelled Drug Testing RFP
cases.text: RFP for employee drug and alcohol testing and collection-site coordination. The contracting office cancelled the solicitation.

cases.title: Stale Firefighter Medical Examination RFP
cases.text: Old request for proposals for firefighter NFPA 1582 occupational medical examinations. The notice is stale and the response period is no longer current.

cases.title: Dead Respirator Clearance Solicitation
cases.text: Former solicitation for respirator medical clearance and spirometry. The procurement page is dead and the opportunity is no longer available.
